parent_v5.key_result: temporal evidence contracted world/source identity but did not increase full-coverage robust-impossibility recovery

scientific_question: Which evidence channels merely distinguish compatible world identities inside the same reachability envelope, and which channels cross a reachability-equivalence boundary and change the possible/impossible spatial target?

baseline.latent_worlds: exact v5 directed candidate source x barrier x analyst-rule universes
baseline.evidence: full dispersed positive occurrence set without arrival-depth constraints
baseline.eligibility: same v5 rows with at least four non-source truth-reachable nodes

equivalence_targets.world_identity: exact source x barrier x analyst-rule world ID
equivalence_targets.reachability_class: two worlds are equivalent when their directed reachable node sets are exactly equal
equivalence_targets.survivor_envelope: union of reachable node sets over the currently surviving worlds
equivalence_targets.robust_impossibility: A/B-permissive nodes outside the survivor envelope

truth_relative_evidence_actions.temporal_depth: apply full truth reached-by-depth upper bounds as frozen in v5
truth_relative_evidence_actions.source_assay: retain only worlds with the frozen truth source
truth_relative_evidence_actions.barrier_assay: retain only worlds with the truth barrier-density level
truth_relative_evidence_actions.analyst_rule_assay: retain only worlds with the truth relative_edge_q70 analyst rule

action_subsets: evaluate all 16 subsets of the four actions including the empty baseline; action semantics are fixed and order-independent intersections

evidence_classification.identity_only: world count decreases but survivor envelope is unchanged
evidence_classification.envelope_changing: survivor envelope loses at least one node

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: At baseline full positives, median survivor-world count divided by distinct reachability-class count is >1.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED if the median compression ratio is <=1.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: At least one truth-relative action in at least one eligible row eliminates worlds while leaving the survivor reachability envelope unchanged.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED if every world-contractive action also changes the envelope.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: At least one truth-relative action in at least one eligible row removes at least one node from the survivor reachability envelope.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED if no action ever changes the envelope.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: Among rows where temporal_depth contracts the baseline world set, at least 90 percent have zero envelope contraction.
At least one eligible row contains two single actions A and B such that A eliminates more worlds than B but A yields fewer newly robust-impossible nodes than B.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED if world-elimination ranking never disagrees with envelope-gain ranking.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: Among rows where exact world identification is possible using the frozen action library, median minimum action count needed to reproduce the all-actions reachability envelope is strictly smaller than median minimum action count needed to identify the exact truth world.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED if the median target-specific saving is nonpositive.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: For every action subset, the truth world survives, survivor envelopes can only contract as actions are added, and no truth-reachable node becomes robustly impossible.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: Any violation is an implementation/theory failure.

secondary_outputs: identity-only / envelope-changing frequency by evidence channel
mean envelope gain by source/barrier/rule/temporal action
minimum action sets for exact world identity
minimum action sets for maximal reachability-envelope contraction
rows where source information changes history identity but not spatial envelope
rows where barrier or analyst-rule calibration changes the spatial envelope
claim_boundary: Reachability equivalence is target-specific: worlds in one class may differ for route, timing or another future target.
Direct source/barrier/rule assays are idealized known-truth evidence channels.
A smaller envelope-target design does not identify the true mechanism world.
Action cardinality is an information count, not empirical field cost.
stop_rules: Do not add evidence actions after scoring.
Do not redefine reachability equivalence after scoring.
Do not drop temporal evidence because v5 showed zero aggregate envelope gain.
Do not change the all-actions target after scoring.
